item.title: Hopewell, Richmond County sheriff's offices continue ICE collaboration after Spanberger's state law enforcement agencies order
item.description: Hopewell Sheriff's Office and Richmond County Sheriff's Office are still working with U.S. Customs and Immigration Enforcement (ICE) after Gov. Abigail Spanberger's (D) recent directive ordering state law enforcement agencies to terminate their ICE agreements.

item.title: Small Virginia child, out-of-state resident sick with measles, creating exposure risk
item.description: Both a small Northern Virginia child and an out-of-state visitor have confirmed cases of measles, creating an exposure risk for anyone who visited the same places around the same times.

item.title: Over $1.9 million in illegal drugs seized across Virginia in just one week: VSP
item.description: More than $1.9 million in illegal narcotics were seized by Virginia State Police (VSP) in just one week as part of ongoing crime suppression operations.

item.title: Money kept from Richmond's affordable housing fund because city had no plan: OCA
item.description: For several years, Richmond's dedicated affordable housing fund did not receive the money it was meant to because no plan was ever put into place to ensure this happened, among other issues, according to city auditors.

item.title: Three adults, one juvenile hurt after 4-vehicle crash, fire in Chesterfield
item.description: Three adults and one juvenile are in the hospital after a four-vehicle crash and resulting fire in Chesterfield County on Friday.

item.title: Dozens of data center bills moving through Virginia General Assembly
item.description: As data center proposals continue to emerge across Central Virginia, lawmakers are pushing a wave of legislation that could bring new regulations to the industry statewide.

item.title: Cumberland Schools chooses not to send kids home on buses due to snow
item.description: Cumberland County schools chose not to send their students home on buses Friday afternoon due to snow, instead asking parents and guardians to come pick up their kids.

item.title: PHOTOS: Another snowfall sweeps through Central Virginia
item.description: Snow began to fall across Central Virginia on Friday, with many areas expected to see a few inches of accumulation.

item.title: Woman accused of intentionally setting Henrico motel on fire
item.description: A woman is accused of intentionally setting a Henrico County motel on fire Friday afternoon, causing significant damage and displacing multiple guests.
